schema.text: Thinking about your usual trip, is the time it actually takes usually shorter, about the same or longer than you expect?

options.text: It varies a lot from day to day

en.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: Thinking about your usual trip, is the time it actually takes usually shorter, about the same or longer than you expect?
en.#It varies a lot from day to day: It varies a lot from day to day

it.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale, il tempo che impieghi davvero è di solito più breve, uguale o più lungo di quello che ti aspetti?
it.#It varies a lot from day to day: Cambia molto da un giorno all’altro

fr.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: Pour votre trajet habituel, le temps qu’il vous faut réellement est-il en général plus court, à peu près égal ou plus long que ce que vous prévoyez ?
fr.#Slightly shorter than expected: Un peu plus court que prévu
fr.#Slightly longer than expected: Un peu plus long que prévu
fr.#It varies a lot from day to day: Cela varie beaucoup d’un jour à l’autre

de.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: Wenn Sie an Ihren üblichen Weg denken: Dauert er tatsächlich meist kürzer, etwa gleich lang oder länger, als Sie erwarten?
de.#It varies a lot from day to day: Das ist von Tag zu Tag sehr unterschiedlich

tr.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: Olağan yolculuğunuzu düşündüğünüzde, gerçekte harcadığınız süre genellikle beklediğinizden daha kısa mı, yaklaşık aynı mı, yoksa daha uzun mu?

fa.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: وقتی به سفر معمول خود فکر می‌کنید، زمانی که واقعاً طول می‌کشد معمولاً کوتاه‌تر، تقریباً برابر یا طولانی‌تر از زمانی است که انتظار دارید؟
fa.#It varies a lot from day to day: از روزی به روز دیگر خیلی فرق می‌کند

hu.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: Ha a szokásos útjára gondol, a ténylegesen eltöltött idő általában rövidebb, nagyjából ugyanannyi vagy hosszabb, mint amire számít?

ar.#Thinking about your usual trip, is the: عند التفكير في تنقّلك المعتاد، هل يكون الوقت الذي يستغرقه فعلًا عادةً أقصر من توقعك أو مساويًا له تقريبًا أو أطول منه؟
